mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of FEDFUNDS easing periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing cycles (IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative in >70% of FEDFUNDS >4.5% instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the returns are not significantly lower than baseline during tightening periods (IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and concurrent fall in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) creates a favorable demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 rises >2% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% (IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4% during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening labor demand, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods when UNRATE <4% (IC <0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO growth (IC <0.05 over 3-year window) or the 60d returns are not significantly higher than baseline during supply expansions (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) above 150,000 new jobs signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >70% of instances where PAYEMS >150000 (t-test p>0.05), or the returns are not significantly higher than baseline during employment surges (IC <0.03 over 1-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in RSAFS (demand) and simultaneous fall in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) amplifies demand for equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 5% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of RSAFS rises >5% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% instances (IC <0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery, simultaneous increases in HOUST (demand) and UNRATE (labor conditions) signal improving economic fundamentals, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 10% and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of post-shock recovery periods with HOUST up >10% and UNRATE up >0.5% (IC <0.03 over 2-year window).
